pages.text: The Akaishi Equipment Forger merges Netherite equipment with Akaishi Ingots into Akaishi equipment:$(br2)$(li)Base cost 50M Chi Energy + Netherite equipment + several Akaishi Ingots$(li)Output has 1.25x the armor/toughness of Netherite$(li)Starts with 4 upgrade slots$(br2)[Semi-Custom System]$(br2)Upgrade points are optional:$(li)Choose from Speed / Damage / Health / Armor / Toughness, repeatable up to 4 total$(li)Each point costs +10M Chi Energy; fewer points means lower cost$(li)Shift-click a stat to undo an allocation$(br2)Once ready, $(bold)click the Forge button$() to craft:$(li)Swapping the input gear or removing the output resets the points for re-allocation
